ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human review with the fact summary (complaint of speeding/hard braking/shoulder overtaking; driver's [threat]-tagged statement F5); no fare adjustment or account flag is ordered by this ruling — human reviewer to assess the safety allegation and the driver's abusive language, and to note no sensor/traffic evidence exists. Advise rider of 995 / driver commercial insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety dispute type (alleged dangerous driving) plus a [threat]-tagged chat fact (F5). Under SAFE-1 and SAFE-2 the system must not auto-adjudicate; forward a factual summary for human review. No monetary remedy is computable: the RydeX fare is a fixed quote and no fare facts exist; F1/F2 show no deviation.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider's clean profile (F6: 2.2 y, rating 4.72, 0 disputes/0 upheld) is context only and cannot establish that the safety allegation is well founded; SAFE-1/SAFE-2 route the case on the allegation and the flagged chat fact (F5), not on profile material.

As framed, the request for human review of the safety allegation is granted; but the claim that F7 justifies any account-level disposition is not applied — profile facts never decide a case, and RD-6 is not engaged because F1 shows no off-route segment (-0.1 km vs optimal).

Accepted that no refund or fare adjustment is due (fixed RydeX quote, no fare facts, F1/F2 show no deviation); to that extent the claim is consistent with the ruling, but it is resolved by SAFE-2/no monetary remedy rather than supporting any finding on the safety allegation.

Correct that F1 records no route deviation and that this is not a route-deviation case (RD-1 not applied); however absence of excess mileage does not disprove harsh braking or shoulder overtaking, so it cannot rebut the safety allegation — the matter still escalates under SAFE-2.

Correct that F2 (16.1 min vs 16 min) and the fixed $24.76 quote yield no monetary remedy; but no time gained likewise does not disprove the braking/overtaking allegations, so the claim is not accepted as clearing the driver under SAFE-2.

F3/F4 show only a routine pre-pickup exchange at 08:27 and say nothing about driving conduct; NS-3 is not applicable because no cancellation occurred, so this does not support any finding on the safety allegation.

F7 (455 trips, 0 disputes, 0 upheld in 90 d) is context only and cannot be used to treat an unverified safety complaint as cleared; safety adjudication under SAFE-1/SAFE-2 is not decided by profile records.
